name: block-metrics
use: Three numbers that prove a claim, each with what it counts: a short number answers «is that actually true?» instead of a paragraph.
avoid: More or fewer than three measures; numbers nobody measured; related values that need a table.
props: { kind: 'block-metrics'; items: { value: string; label: string }[] }

cases.title: Three numbers about a service: languages, access tiers, roles
cases.why: Each number is measured and says what it counts.

cases.title: Stats of a product launch: sign-ups, uptime, response time
cases.why: Proof in numbers right after the claim it supports.

items.label: people signed up in the first month

docs: npx shadcn add @fractera/block-metrics. In a page: { "kind": "block-metrics", "items": [ { "value": "82", "label": "…" }, … three items ] }. The value is not translated; the label is a page string.
